record.name: Plaid
record.one_liner: Plaid provides financial and fintech APIs to connect user bank accounts, verify identity, and enable money movement.

auth.notes: Requests require a client_id and secret, passed either in request headers (PLAID-CLIENT-ID, PLAID-SECRET) or in the request body.

access.notes: Developers can sign up on the Plaid Dashboard to obtain credentials and start testing in the Sandbox environment.

api_surface.notes: The Plaid API is JSON over HTTPS with server-side API libraries and client-side components like Link.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials are readily available via the dashboard, and the API is fully documented with client libraries and a Sandbox environment.

evidence.claim: The Plaid API uses JSON over HTTP with client_id and secret sent via headers or request body.
Developers can obtain API keys by signing up in the Dashboard and starting in the Sandbox environment.
Plaid sends webhooks as HTTP POST requests to inform applications about asynchronous changes.
